description: Each recent build's size per platform (the .ipa and .aab the build machine sent), with the change from the build before it, and a warning when an iPhone build passes 200 MB, past which iPhones ask before downloading it over cellular data. Use it after a build that grew, or before adding a big dependency or asset.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
